coder_note: Full text read 2026-11-08 (OCR, refs/P4W-07). Reference antigen = crude detergent-solubilized lysate of IDE8 tick-cell-propagated A. marginale, harvested at 80-100% CPE (a rickettsial agent, not a virus - veterinary analogue). MAb ANAF16C1 targets MSP5, a conserved A. marginale surface protein.
